sents.en: Plain Markdown — requirements with concrete scenarios, no special syntax to learn.
sents.zh: 就是普通的 Markdown —— 带有具体场景的需求，无需学习任何特殊语法。

sents.en: Here's what goes in the specs/ folder created above:
sents.zh: 下面是上文创建的 specs/ 文件夹中的内容：

paragraphs.en: ## ADDED Requirements ### Requirement: Theme selection The app SHALL let users switch between light and dark themes, defaulting to the system preference. #### Scenario: User toggles dark mode - ** WHEN ** the user clicks the theme toggle - ** THEN ** the app switches to dark mode and persists the choice Your AI writes these; you review the plan before any code is written.
paragraphs.zh: ## 新增需求 ### 需求：主题选择 应用应让用户在浅色和深色主题之间切换，默认遵循系统偏好。 #### 场景：用户切换深色模式 - **当**用户点击主题切换按钮 - **那么**应用切换到深色模式并保存该选择 你的 AI 智能体编写这些内容；你在编写任何代码之前审查该计划。

paragraphs.en: OpenSpec is built with OpenSpec — browse this repo's live specs and in-flight changes for real examples at scale.
paragraphs.zh: OpenSpec 本身就是用 OpenSpec 构建的——浏览本仓库的实际规格说明与进行中的变更，查看大规模的真实示例。

paragraphs.en: Solo, OpenSpec keeps you and your AI honest on a single repo. On a team, the hard part moves: a feature spans the API server, the web app, and a shared library; requirements are owned by one team and consumed by others; planning starts before any code exists.
paragraphs.zh: 单人使用时，OpenSpec 能让你和你的 AI 在单个仓库上保持诚实。 团队协作时，难点发生了转移：一个功能横跨 API 服务器、Web 应用和一个共享库；需求由一个团队拥有、被其他团队消费；规划在任何代码存在之前就已开始。

sents.en: Solo, OpenSpec keeps you and your AI honest on a single repo.
sents.zh: 单人使用时，OpenSpec 能让你和你的 AI 在单个仓库上保持诚实。

sents.en: On a team, the hard part moves: a feature spans the API server, the web app, and a shared library; requirements are owned by one team and consumed by others; planning starts before any code exists.

paragraphs.en: Stores are the answer — planning in a repo of its own. The same openspec/ shape you already know (specs and changes), shared by git push like anything else. One source of truth your whole team and every coding agent can read, across every repo.
paragraphs.zh: Store 就是答案——在一个独立的仓库中进行规划。 使用你已经熟悉的 openspec/ 结构（包含 specs 和 changes），像其他任何东西一样通过 git push 共享。 一个唯一的事实来源，你的整个团队和每个智能体都可以跨所有仓库读取它。

paragraphs.en: Install OpenSpec. It is a single file and needs no Node.js (on Alpine Linux, first run apk add libstdc++ libgcc ).
paragraphs.zh: 安装 OpenSpec。 它是单个文件，无需 Node.js（在 Alpine Linux 上，请先运行 apk add libstdc++ libgcc）。

sents.zh: 安装 OpenSpec。

paragraphs.en: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/main/scripts/binary/install.sh | sh Windows (PowerShell):

paragraphs.en: Then navigate to your project directory and initialize:
paragraphs.zh: 然后导航到你的项目目录并进行初始化：

paragraphs.en: cd your-project openspec init Want your AI to do it? Paste the setup prompt into your coding assistant — it installs the CLI, runs openspec init , and verifies the result.
paragraphs.zh: cd your-project openspec init 想让你的 AI 来完成？ 将安装提示粘贴到你的编程助手中 — 它会安装 CLI、运行 openspec init，并验证结果。

paragraphs.en: Both are in the default profile. If you want the expanded workflow ( /opsx:new , /opsx:continue , /opsx:ff , /opsx:verify , /opsx:bulk-archive , /opsx:onboard ), select it with openspec config profile and apply with openspec update .
paragraphs.zh: 两者都在默认配置文件中。 如果你想要扩展的工作流（/opsx:new、/opsx:continue、/opsx:ff、/opsx:verify、/opsx:bulk-archive、/opsx:onboard），请使用 openspec config profile 选择它，并用 openspec update 应用。

paragraphs.en: /opsx:propose is the canonical name; your tool may spell it /opsx-propose (Cursor, GitHub Copilot), @opsx-propose (Amazon Q) or $openspec-propose (Codex). openspec init prints the right form for the tools you picked — see Supported Tools .
paragraphs.zh: /opsx:propose 是规范名称；你的工具可能将其写作 /opsx-propose（Cursor、GitHub Copilot）、@opsx-propose（Amazon Q）或 $openspec-propose（Codex）。openspec init 会为你所选的工具打印正确的形式——参见 Supported Tools。

paragraphs.en: Third-party schema bundles distributed via standalone repositories — these provide opinionated workflows that integrate OpenSpec with other tools, similar to how github/spec-kit's community extension catalog handles tool integrations.
paragraphs.zh: 通过独立代码仓库分发的第三方 schema 包——这些包提供了将 OpenSpec 与其他工具集成的自选工作流，类似于 github/spec-kit 的社区扩展目录处理工具集成的方式。

paragraphs.en: AI coding assistants are powerful but unpredictable when requirements live only in chat history. OpenSpec adds a lightweight spec layer so you agree on what to build before any code is written.
paragraphs.zh: 当需求仅存在于聊天记录中时，AI 编程助手虽然强大但难以预测。 OpenSpec 增加了一个轻量级的规格层，让你在编写任何代码之前先就构建什么达成一致。

sents.en: OpenSpec adds a lightweight spec layer so you agree on what to build before any code is written.
sents.zh: OpenSpec 增加了一个轻量级的规格层，让你在编写任何代码之前先就构建什么达成一致。

paragraphs.en: vs. Spec Kit (GitHub) — Thorough but heavyweight. Rigid phase gates, lots of Markdown, Python setup. OpenSpec is lighter and lets you iterate freely.
paragraphs.zh: 对比。 Spec Kit（GitHub）——全面但较为笨重。 阶段门限僵化，Markdown 文件繁多，还需配置 Python 环境。 OpenSpec 更轻量，让你可以自由迭代。

paragraphs.en: Run this inside each project to regenerate AI guidance and ensure the latest slash commands are active:

paragraphs.en: Every change starts as an issue. We discuss it there, and if we agree to pursue it, a maintainer implements the change or invites you to build it with us.

paragraphs.en: OpenSpec collects anonymous usage stats.
paragraphs.zh: OpenSpec 会收集匿名使用统计信息。

paragraphs.en: We collect only command names and version to understand usage patterns. No arguments, paths, content, or PII. Automatically disabled in CI.
paragraphs.zh: 我们仅收集命令名称和版本来了解使用模式。 不收集参数、路径、内容或个人身份信息。 在 CI 环境中会自动禁用。
